answer: Standing is an onyx that only shines when it is polished by fresh hands: each epoch’s work must be verified by established peers who have never verified this identity before — a nadir of standing is the lowest count of fresh verifiers in any single epoch, and an island of trust only stays above water when fresh hands keep polishing it. A farm of a thousand fakes has no fresh hands: its members verify each other again and again, so each fake must find strangers outside its farm who have never verified it before — and one epoch verified only by familiar hands adds nothing.
